installed_header.observed: MarshalledProperty stores property-key presence in MPresent; KernelPropertyHolderStructTy includes use_root_sync_key. This header alone is not proof of a driver limit or a stall cause.

primary_reference.paraphrase: The extension makes use_root_sync launches compatible with root-group synchronization and constrains work-group counts. Removing it is appropriate to test when the kernel uses no root-group synchronization.
primary_reference.limits: The branch specification can differ from installed compiler/runtime. The device maximum was not queried, and an invalid range, undefined behavior, prevention or causal link to stalls is not established.
